info.name: PCH - Merchant and Store Onboarding - Latest
info.description: Updated 2026-09-16. New two-stage onboarding and existing store APIs. Run login, inspect active masters, allocate IDs, create merchant, then add stores. Choose an existing active commercial plan/store-type code. Requests are examples to run individually: alternate create-store routes must not all be run with the same ID. No payment or access provisioning: device/role/feature selections are configuration drafts. New onboarding subscriptions/stores remain PENDING. Omitted stores are preserved. Requires latest merchant-service code and additive migration 08_store_onboarding_setup.sql (also applied on service startup).

request.description: Enter your local account credentials. Tokens are saved only in your local collection variables.

exec: if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) { const data = pm.response.json(); const token = data.accessToken || data.data?.accessToken; if (token) pm.collectionVariables.set("accessToken", token); }

request.description: Set planCode to an existing active plans master code.
Set storeTypeCode to an existing active master code.
Reserves a new server-wide merchant code.
Reserves a new server-wide store code.

item.name: Create merchant and pending subscription — no stores yet

request.description: First stage. Change merchantEmail for each new merchant. All writes are atomic.

    "code": "{{merchantId}}",
    "business": "Example Retail LLC",
